witness.setEquality: the complete V3 imported LEGACY_JSON canonical player owner-locator set equals the BAG_CONTAINER witness owner-locator set in both directions; missing, extra, and duplicate owners fail closed

projectionFingerprint: sha256(stable JSON of player/run/witness/semantic hashes/counts/import-commit stack baseline/import-commit ledger baseline/revision/active flag)
typedBaseline: stack child rows preserve player/item/stack/baseline quantity; ledger child rows preserve entry ID, operation ID, player/item, stack-or-instance target, delta, reason, deterministic baseline ordinal, and a fingerprint over exactly those typed ledger fields excluding audit values
ledgerOrdering: migration backfill ordinal is a deterministic immutable baseline set order, not historical time; only inserts after the captured baseline head are a DB-enforced per-player monotonic sequence
readinessContinuation: baseline typed children must equal the live baseline entries exactly; all current sequences 1..head must be gap-free; baseline stack quantity plus post-baseline deltas must equal the exact current stack set, including stacks first created after import
forbiddenReadinessRule: current stack or ledger state must not be required to equal the import-commit baseline
excludedState: PET-EQUIPMENT frozen state belongs to consumer actual-read validation
